description: This file defines a PHP class smpl_Invoice_Sample that generates a PDF invoice template sample. It contains methods to get invoice type, body, header, and footer HTML content, referencing external translation and service functions.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Sample
classes.description: A class responsible for generating a sample invoice PDF template with methods to return invoice content, header, and footer HTML.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the invoice, which is 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the HTML content for the invoice body, including company info, invoice details, and line items.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header HTML content for the PDF, currently empty.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer HTML containing page number and date placeholders.
